Reference / http/media_type

http/media_type#

Media types as HTTP uses them (RFC 9110 §8.3.1): Content-Type and the like.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let type = HttpMediaType("text/html; charset=UTF-8");
type::Type::type;                                 // "text"
type.parameters().first("charset");               // "utf-8"
HttpMediaType("application", "json", HttpMediaParameters()).string();

Description#

Media types as HTTP uses them (RFC 9110 §8.3.1): Content-Type and the like.

Type, subtype and parameter names are case-insensitive and kept lowercase; so is a charset value, while other values are exact. Unlike mime/media_type, there is no RFC 2231 assembly of parameters. Input is bounded by HttpMediaLimits (8192 bytes and 128 parameters by default).

Public API#

object HttpMediaParameter#

object HttpMediaParameter does Comparing<HttpMediaParameter>

HTTP parameters retain literal extension names: no MIME RFC2231 assembly. Charset is a case-insensitive token identity; other parameter values are exact.
